name: Hotel Elora
area: Moreh town, ~10 min from Tamu border
why_it_matters: The most-cited 3-star property in Moreh and effectively the de-facto traveller cafeteria of the India-Myanmar border town — about 10 minutes from the Tamu crossing. Reviewers consistently flag the breakfast as the meal to plan around; lunch/dinner menu items can run out.
insider_tip: Plan a sit-down meal at breakfast — non-breakfast service can be unreliable. Outside of Elora, eating in Moreh means walking the main street and choosing between Tamil idli-dosa shops and Manipuri rice hotels — none have stable online listings.
